key_insight: An agent-assisted experimental strategy was reused and refined across four additional three-qubit NMR processors to perform Grover state preparation.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-driven adaptation could reduce expert workload when transferring quantum experiments between devices with different calibration and control requirements.
method: Develop the strategy on one processor, then deploy sequentially on four others.
Use an agent to assess evidence, choose measurements and adapt calibration, pulse optimization and measurement procedures.
Retain operators for instrument preparation and physical intervention.
evidence_signal: All four target processors produced marked-state-dominated outputs; marked-state populations in reconstructed dominant eigenstates ranged from 0.910 to 0.959, with relative deviations below 3.8% from the ideal 0.945.
watch_item: Results are limited to three-qubit NMR processors and one common task, with human intervention still required.
paper_title: Agent-assisted experimental strategy transfer across quantum processors
